mapper.select: SELECT tt.id, tt.yy, tt.mm, tt.dayname, tt.period_no, tt.start_time, tt.end_time, tt.time_table_key, tt.created_at, tt.updated_at, tt.user_code, cc.class_name, sa.week, u.center_code FROM erp_time_table tt JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key JOIN erp_user u ON tt.user_code = u.user_code JOIN erp_student_attendance sa ON tt.time_table_key = sa.time_table_key WHERE tt.yy = #{yy} AND tt.mm = #{mm} AND tt.dayname = #{dayname} AND tt.end_time <= CAST(#{nowTimeHHmm} AS TIME)
mapper.insert: UPDATE erp_student_attendance SET attendance_date = #{attendanceDate}, attendance_key = 'absent' WHERE week = #{week} AND in_time IS NULL AND time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND attendance_key = 'before'

INSERT INTO erp_remedial (student_id, time_table_key, remedial_subject, absence_date, remedial_date, action, week, yy, mm, created_at, user_code, remedial_key) SELECT s.student_id, tt.time_table_key, cc.class_name, #{absenceDate}, '9999-12-31', 0, #{week}, #{yy}, #{mm}, SYSDATETIME(), tt.user_code, CONCAT( REPLACE(CONVERT(char (10), #{absenceDate}, 23), '-', ''), LEFT(tt.time_table_key, 4), s.student_id, #{week} ) FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_student s ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_time_table tt ON tt.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE tt.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_student_attendance sa WHERE sa.student_id = s.student_id AND sa.attendance_date = #{absenceDate} AND sa.attendance_key = 'absent') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_remedial r WHERE r.student_id = s.student_id AND r.time_table_key = tt.time_table_key AND r.absence_date = #{absenceDate})

INSERT INTO erp_remedial (student_id, time_table_key, remedial_subject, absence_date, remedial_date, action, week, yy, mm, created_at, user_code, remedial_key) SELECT #{studentId}, tt.time_table_key, cc.class_name, #{absenceDate}, '9999-12-31', 0, #{week}, #{yy}, #{mm}, SYSDATETIME(), tt.user_code, CONCAT( REPLACE(CONVERT(char (10), #{absenceDate}, 23), '-', ''), LEFT(tt.time_table_key, 4), #{studentId}, #{week} ) FROM erp_time_table tt JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE tt.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_remedial r WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} AND r.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND r.week = #{week} AND r.absence_date = #{absenceDate});
